sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The RB-KPRL key (RB-KPRL) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Federal State Reserve Agency base Radar Station guardhouse.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Southern most small building at the radio tower on Reserve.Guard Building outside of the Radar Tower on Reserve.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- One Standing Weapon Safe
- One Safe
- One Weapon Cabinet
- One Weapon box (6x2)
- One small safe under desk
- Two intelligence spawns, on the desk and on top of the safe
